fields.description: Sobha Solis comprises four residential towers above a shared residents’ podium in Motor City. One- to three-bedroom apartments, including a marketed 1.5-bedroom category, sit alongside facilities focused on fitness, social activities and the nearby motorsport setting.

overview: The brochure describes an Arsenal-branded fitness space only for a defined period, conditional on continuation of the partnership. Purchasers should assess the facility itself and confirm the branding term. Detailed reviewed layouts belong to Tower A.
research.locationNote: Motor City, Dubai, near Al Qudra Road and Hessa Street. Motorsport-facing homes may experience a different outlook and sound environment; inspect the actual tower orientation.
research.priceNote: Sobha currently advertises AED 2.00 m subject to inventory. Property Finder retains an AED 1 m launch guide and a sold-out flag, neither of which confirms current developer stock or the price of a selected apartment.
research.paymentNote: Property Finder reports 60% during construction and 40% at handover. Booking allocations and instalment dates were not established from a dated primary schedule; obtain the selected offer before calculating cash flow.
research.handoverNote: FY2024 reports 2027. Property Finder currently estimates December 2028. Confirm the selected tower’s contractual date.
